aggressive.name: Offensive
aggressive.text: One stack attacks an adjacent enemy for free. {points} points: +1 strength each, or {extraCost} for another attack.

J.name: Surprise
J.text: Trench chips do not count for the defender.

A.name: Breakthrough
A.text: A winner is not spent, and the loser loses 1 more man.

defensive.name: Defence
defensive.text: {points} points: a trench chip (+1 defence, max {limit} per hex) or +{braceAmount} defence until your next turn, on a stack.

J.name: Elastic defence
J.text: Your retreats are free until your next turn.

Q.name: Reserves
Q.text: All your stacks get +1 defence until your next turn.

K.name: Iron wall
K.text: Bracing gives +2, trenches may be one deeper.

A.name: Hold the line
A.text: Elastic defence, +1 defence for all, bracing +2, deeper trenches.

reorganizational.name: Logistics
reorganizational.text: {points} points: rail +{railHexes} hexes of movement (1), rally +1 gear up to {limit} (2), merge adjacent stacks (1), split a stack (1).

K.name: Depots
K.text: Rallying costs 1 and may go one higher.

willingness.name: Home Front
willingness.text: {points} points: propaganda +{propaganda} resolve (1), relief -{relief} war weariness (1), recruit +1 man in a home stack (2).

A.name: Total war
A.text: All three: strong propaganda and relief, cheap recruits.
